resources.title: Product launch brief
resources.description: Turn a product idea into one audience, one proof point and a clear next step.
contents: What are you launching? Write one sentence.
Who is it for? Name one specific audience.
What frustrating moment does it improve?
Which real product action proves the benefit?
What should the viewer do next?
resources.use: Start a launch video with these questions in your creative brief.

resources.title: Starter brand kit
resources.description: A readable palette, Inter typography and a concise voice for your next project.
contents: White background · #ffffff
Cobalt accent · #2142e7
Navy text · #182b4e
Inter typography
Voice: clear, curious and useful.
resources.use: Create a new branded project so your existing project colors stay intact.

resources.title: Product demo shot list
resources.description: Capture the screens you need for a clear product demo, from opening state to final result.
contents: Product name or opening title
Starting screen showing the problem
Cursor or finger at the real control
The action recorded without interruption
The result held long enough to read
One useful caption in plain language
Closing frame with one next step
resources.use: Add the checklist to the brief of a new walkthrough.

resources.title: Three-scene storyboard
resources.description: Plan the problem, product action and result before opening the timeline.
contents: The problem: show a recognizable starting state.
The action: demonstrate one useful product interaction.
The result: hold on the outcome and name the next step.
resources.use: Create an editable storyboard with three independent frames.

resources.title: Feature demo script
resources.description: A short script that explains one feature without narrating every click.
contents: Opening: Here is how to [complete the task].
Context: Start with [the required screen or content].
Action: Choose [the control] to [perform the action].
Result: You now have [the visible result].
Close: Try it with [a useful next input].
resources.use: Create a feature video with the script ready in its brief.

resources.title: Product scene prompts
resources.description: Reusable prompts for thinking through a launch, a feature demo and a product update.
contents: Plan a four-scene launch for [product] and [audience]. Use only these verified features: [list].
Suggest three ways to explain [feature] using this real screenshot: [reference].
Rewrite this caption in our brand voice without changing its claim: [caption].
Compare these scene ideas for clarity, product fidelity and reading time.
resources.use: Keep the prompt collection in a new video brief; adapt it before making an AI request.

resources.title: Vertical video checklist
resources.description: Check crops, captions and interface readability before publishing a portrait video.
contents: Choose 9:16 before framing.
Keep the meaningful control large enough to read.
Keep captions clear of the captured action.
Check the start and end of every scene.
Preview on a phone-sized screen.
resources.use: Start a portrait app video with the checklist attached to its brief.

resources.title: Release update storyboard
resources.description: Give a release its own opening, feature proof and invitation to try.
contents: What changed: name the update in plain language.
Where it lives: show the new control in context.
How it works: perform one useful action.
Try it: close on the result and next step.
resources.use: Create a four-frame storyboard you can attach to a product project.

resources.title: Customer story brief
resources.description: Collect the context, permissions and evidence behind a useful customer story.
contents: Who is the customer and who approved the story?
What task were they trying to complete?
Which recording demonstrates the real workflow?
What result can you support with evidence?
Which exact quote is approved for publication?
resources.use: Start a customer-story edit with the evidence questions in its brief.

resources.title: YouTube tutorial script
resources.description: An outcome-first outline for a tutorial with a clear beginning and useful chapters.
contents: Show the finished result.
List the starting materials or settings.
Demonstrate the task in distinct steps.
Explain how to check the result.
Link to one next lesson.
resources.use: Create a landscape tutorial edit with chapter-ready scenes.

resources.title: Calm brand kit
resources.description: A white, evergreen and ink palette for thoughtful product demonstrations.
contents: White background · #ffffff
Evergreen accent · #20816c
Ink text · #203c36
Inter typography
Voice: calm, specific and helpful.
resources.use: Create a fresh project with this palette without changing an existing brand.

resources.title: Caption writing prompts
resources.description: Write concise captions that explain value while leaving the interface room to speak.
contents: Shorten this caption to one clear idea: [text].
Describe the visible result without narrating the click: [action].
Write three accurate opening captions for this product action: [context].
Check this caption against the screenshot. Remove anything the image does not support.
resources.use: Add caption prompts to the brief of a new feature video.
